Launch the #TidyTuesday Data Viewer

launch.Rd

Launch the #TidyTuesday Data Viewer

Usage

launch(mode = c("start", "run"), options = list(), run = "b", ...)

Arguments

mode

"start" (default) calls shiny::startApp() and returns the ShinyAppHandle. The app runs in the background and the console stays available (see Details). "run" returns the shiny.appobj for shiny::runApp() to run; the console is blocked until the app stops. Use "run" in an app.R file for deployment.

options

List of options passed to shiny::shinyApp().

run

Display mode for interactive RStudio or Positron sessions, passed to display_type(). Default "b" (external browser).

...

In mode = "start", additional arguments passed to shiny::startApp() (e.g., port, host). Ignored in mode = "run".

Value

mode = "run": a shiny.appobj. mode = "start": a ShinyAppHandle.

Details

mode = "start" needs Shiny >= 1.14.0. The returned handle has status(), url(), result(), and stop(). Call handle$stop() from the console to shut the app down; starting a new app stops the one already running.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
if (interactive()) {
  # non-blocking: the console stays available while the app runs
  handle <- launch()
  handle$url()
  handle$stop()

  # blocking: what app.R uses for deployment
  launch(mode = "run")
}
} # }
